objective: Standard statement: confirm ticket A by exact computation and extend it to non-planar glue: on all minimal maps of the Fano space and the 13-point space, and on minimal maps of the larger spaces up to 43 points, every face has length 2 mod 4, every vertex lies on three distinct faces, the Cimasoni-Reshetikhin form is well defined and vanishes on all matching differences, its Arf invariant is 0, and the matching differences realize exactly 3^h classes for h Fano atoms; trisums of prisms (non-planar glue) are rigid, Kasteleyn with their Pfaffian signing on all their minimal maps, and have Arf invariant 0; on the Heawood torus the four Kasteleyn classes have determinants 24, 8, 8, -8 and only the knot's computes the matching count. Nearest known result: ticket A. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved by exact computation: every space up to 22 points is Kasteleyn and even on its minimal maps with exactly 3^h realized classes; trisum glue behaves like Fano atoms; Heawood Kasteleyn determinants 24, 8, 8, 8; odd spin structures only on non-minimal maps of genus 3 and up
title: The spin structure by computation
